saw_lines: Frozen meat buyers decide once, on trust, then reorder the same cut without comparing again.
So the trust is won or lost in the first line, before a new buyer clicks a box they cannot touch.
Your site shows 100,000+ orders and 4,000+ five-star reviews, yet only 2 of 30 ads carry either. Put 100,000+ orders on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 11 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 100,000+ orders and 4,000+ five-star reviews, yet only 2 of 30 ads carry either number. New buyers need that proof before they click. Put 100,000+ orders on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 22 copy ads mention any offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Open three new ads with 10% off your first order, printed on the creative.

Your site lists prices from $11.00 to $27.99, but none of your 30 ads mention price or cost. Shoppers compare before they click, so silence reads as expensive. Lead one ad with the price per box or per pound.
Your 22 copy ads open with 10 different stories, and the biggest leads only 4 ads. Build the next batch from two openers, the chicken line and the every box line, and stop spreading new ones.

ads_1: Proof and first-order offer openers, tested against the chicken story.
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
